denial.expiry_check: `python WR_scratch/wr_wordscreen.py game/boss/bosscam LimitCamVal2` (or `wf_word_diff` for the count) -- the denial expires the moment +0x13c stops reading a BRANCH-class difference, i.e. as soon as any source form makes our `ble` carry the target's displacement.
denial.falsifier: Any state of this function in which every differing word is REGFIELD-ONLY, or in which a permutation window covering +0x13c..+0x148 contains no control op. Either would put the residual back inside a shipped class.
denial.premise_measurement: `python tools/gdl/composed_census/wf_word_diff.py game/boss/bosscam LimitCamVal2` at 4726b33ca: 88 insns, DIFFERING WORDS = 29, MNEMONIC DIVERGENCE = 5, RELOC-SYMBOL MISMATCH = 0, PINNED = no. Per-word decode over all 29: REGFIELD-ONLY 23, OPCODE 5, BRANCH 1 -- 6 words outside every register-field class. THE DECIDING WORD is +0x13c, `ours 4081000c / target 40810008`: both are `ble`, the xor is 0x00000004, and the whole difference is the BD displacement (target branches to +0x144, ours to +0x148). register_slot_mask returns 0 for a branch, so copy_register_fields cannot touch it; permute_instruction_atoms refuses any region containing a control op, so no permutation can move it or its neighbours. The underlying fact is a control-flow SHAPE difference, not a schedule one: on the `le` path the target executes TWO fmr (+0x144 `fmr f4,f2` falling into +0x148 `fmr f3,f4`) and our stream executes ONE (+0x148 `fmr f3,f0`), which is why the merge and the branch pair compensate.
denial.scope: The POSTPROCESSOR path for game/boss/bosscam::LimitCamVal2 only. It says nothing about the source path: NM's compensating-pair denial still governs the helper-body statement-shape class, and the source residual remains open.
